name: chrome-devtools
description: Chrome DevTools MCP server. Gives the agent browser-automation tools (navigate, click, screenshot, console messages, network requests, performance traces) routed through the AI Firewall MCP Security Gateway. Runs Chromium in a controlled environment via the official Chrome DevTools Protocol MCP package.
author: AI Firewall
notes: Disabled by default — enabling spawns a Chromium process which has a non-trivial resource footprint.
Enable from the proxy command: /mcp enable chrome-devtools
Or set `enabled: true` in this manifest and restart the proxy.

All browser tool calls (navigate, click, evaluate_script, take_screenshot, etc.) route through the MCP Security Gateway at /v1/mcp/tools/call — the firewall's scanner pipeline inspects every input/output before they reach the agent.
